followup_specification.method: Rerun all six original profiles, all three paired repeats, original complete-call boundary, allocation traces, physical-count replays and unchanged acceptance gates after a principled public-batched reduction change. Preserve the initial failed report unchanged. No timing samples or algorithm profiles may be removed.

method.complete_call: Prepared solver invocation, canonical JSON UTF-8 serialization and payload SHA-256; loaders, replay and GC are outside timing.
method.independent_replay: Pinned physical counts and independent numeric betting rules are used outside timed calls, once per distinct backend/profile payload hash.
method.pairing: Three complete calls per backend/profile; order alternates by repeat. All raw payloads, hashes, UTC intervals, coarse phases and failures are retained.
method.preflights: All six Python/reference and native complete-solve admission forecasts finish before native build manifest/executable lookup or any trainer call.
method.scope: Two prepared finite games and the measured source-built binary/runtime only; observed speed ratios are not general speedup or convergence claims.
method.traces: Separate preflop CFR+ 1,000-iteration Python/native calls. Python tracemalloc is Python-process-only; native subprocess memory and RSS are excluded.

work_budget.scope: Full requested training and exact diagnostics, with at most three categorical rows per pair. Source bookkeeping excludes internal hand-ranking instructions; rank calls are independently bounded before ranking. Logical counts are not bytecode, elapsed time, allocation bytes or RSS bounds.

source_admission.scope: Logical exact ranking work and grouped output rows; not elapsed time, allocated bytes or RSS.

vector_upper_bound.loop_entry_scope: Conservative modeled vector-backend validation, aggregation, row setup/normalization, training, and diagnostic loop envelope; not bytecode count, runtime, or process RSS. World enumeration and tree construction use separate existing guards.

admission.scope: Full requested native training and Python adapter bookkeeping; the calling solver separately retains its historical admission and exact Python diagnostics. Logical loop/allocation reservations are not runtime, actual allocated Python bytes or process RSS.

payload.scope: Approximate equilibrium of a finite heads-up preflop betting abstraction with hidden full-deck final-board W/T/L settlement at every nonfolded closed betting line. All-in and limped lines go directly to forced checkdown; no board cards are revealed, and no postflop decisions, antes, rake or multiway play are modeled.

historical_equity_preparation.scope: Exact unordered five-card boards per compatible private pair; logical counts, not time or memory guarantees.

work_budget.scope: Conservative configuration-derived tree/row forecasts, full requested scalar CFR traversal and exact evaluation/own-hand best responses, plus table/setup/output bookkeeping. Forecasts may reject a configuration whose realized tree would be smaller. Source-inclusive mode also charges historical full-board preparation/bookkeeping (rank instructions are separately capped, excluded from these loop units); prepared-counts charges current table work only. No current ranking. Not bytecode, elapsed time, allocation bytes or RSS bounds; trusted counts require independent provenance. Pair-mean indexing aggregates each private pair's hidden W/T/L categories to a conditional signed mean computed as a Fraction before binary64 conversion; its setup charge is included above. Floating-point summation order may differ.

native.trace_scope: Python process allocations only. Native mode excludes child process, native allocations, OS memory and RSS.

acceptance.quality_scope: Report target pass/miss for both backends on all six profiles. Only CFR+ quality is mandatory; preserve every vanilla/DCFR miss without changing checkpoints or gates.

specification.timing_boundary: Each complete call includes prepared solver invocation, canonical JSON UTF-8 serialization and payload SHA-256. Input loaders, garbage collection, phase-wrapper installation, independent replay, source checks and oracle construction are outside timing.

traces.scope: Separate from complete-call medians. Tracing starts after GC and phase-wrapper setup, immediately before the timed prepared solver call; it stops after canonical JSON UTF-8 serialization and payload SHA-256. Python tracemalloc reports Python-process allocations only; for native calls it excludes the child process, native allocations, OS memory and RSS. No RSS claim.
